statement: ∀ (a : ℂ) (s : Finset ℂ), a ≠ 0 → s.Nonempty → (∀ z ∈ s, ∃ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 ∧ (q : ℂ) * a = z) → ∃ b : ℂ, b ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ z ∈ s, ∃ r : Chevalley.R p, r • b = z) ∧ ∃ z ∈ s, ∃ u : ℚ, u ∈ Chevalley.R p ∧ u⁻¹ ∈ Chevalley.R p ∧ u ≠ 0 ∧ z = (u : ℂ) * b
proof:
classical
intro a s ha hs hrep
have hf := @yui_aux_0001 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T010
have hsmul := @yui_aux_0003 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T010
have hpow := @yui_aux_0004 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T010
choose q hq0 hqa using (fun z : s => hrep z z.property)
choose n u hu hui hu0 hqu using (fun z : s => hf (q z) (hq0 z))
haveI : Nonempty s := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩⟩
obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_min_image n Finset.univ_nonempty
have hp0 : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h_H001.1.ne_zero
let b : ℂ := (((p : ℚ) ^ n j : ℚ) : ℂ) * a
have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast zpow_ne_zero (n j) hp0) ha
refine ⟨b, hb0, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro z hz
  let i : s := ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hni : 0 ≤ n i - n j := sub_nonneg.mpr (hj i (Finset.mem_univ i))
  let r : Chevalley.R p := ⟨(p : ℚ) ^ (n i - n j) * u i,
    (Chevalley.R p).mul_mem (hpow _ hni) (hu i)⟩
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  rw [hsmul]
  change (((p : ℚ) ^ (n i - n j) * u i : ℚ) : ℂ) *
    ((((p : ℚ) ^ n j : ℚ) : ℂ) * a) = z
  have heq : ((p : ℚ) ^ (n i - n j) * u i) * (p : ℚ) ^ n j = q i := by
    rw [hqu i, zpow_sub₀ hp0]
    field_simp
  calc
    _ = ((((p : ℚ) ^ (n i - n j) * u i) * (p : ℚ) ^ n j : ℚ) : ℂ) * a := by
      exact @yui_aux_0005 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T010 _ _ a
    _ = (q i : ℂ) * a := by rw [heq]
    _ = z := hqa i
· refine ⟨j, j.property, u j, hu j, hui j, hu0 j, ?_⟩
  calc
    (j : ℂ) = (q j : ℂ) * a := (hqa j).symm
    _ = (u j : ℂ) * b := by
      rw [hqu j, Rat.cast_mul]
      dsimp [b]
      ring

checked : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ)
  (ell : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    ((∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), Chevalley.J p M y v ↑i = Chevalley.J p M y v 0) ∧
          (Chevalley.J p M y v 0).FG ∧
            Chevalley.J p M y v 0 ≠ ⊥ ∧
              ∀ (u : V),
                u ∈ Chevalley.image p M ↔
                  ∃! c,
                    (∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), c i ∈ Chevalley.J p M y v 0) ∧ u = ∑ i, c i • Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
        (Function.Injective ⇑(Chevalley.qmul p M y v) ∧
            (Chevalley.qmul p M y v).range = Chevalley.QJ p M y v ∧
              FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] ↥(Chevalley.J p M y v 0)) ∧
                FiniteDimensional ℚ ↥(Chevalley.QJ p M y v)) ∧
          Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] Chevalley.MR p M) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
            ell.toNat + 1 = (ell.toNat + 1) * Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] ↥(Chevalley.J p M y v 0)) ∧
              Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] ↥(Chevalley.J p M y v 0)) = 1 ∧
                Module.finrank ℚ ↥(Chevalley.QJ p M y v) = 1 →
      ∀ (a : ℂ) (s : Finset ℂ),
        a ≠ 0 →
          s.Nonempty →
            (∀ z ∈ s, ∃ q, q ≠ 0 ∧ ↑q * a = z) →
              ∃ b,
                b ≠ 0 ∧
                  (∀ z ∈ s, ∃ r, r • b = z) ∧ ∃ z ∈ s, ∃ u ∈ Chevalley.R p, u⁻¹ ∈ Chevalley.R p ∧ u ≠ 0 ∧ z = ↑u * b
